reasoning_content: Now rebuild the APK with these fixes.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Rebuild APK
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
export PATH=/opt/gradle-8.5/bin:$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH
cd /opt/areloria/client/android
nohup /opt/gradle-8.5/bin/gradle clean assembleDebug > /tmp/gradle.log 2>&1 &
echo "Building..." """)

print("🏗️ Rebuilding APK...")

time.sleep(80)

stdin, stdout, stderr = c.exec_command("tail -10 /tmp/gradle.log")
print(stdout.read().decode())

# Copy to webroot
c.exec_command("cp /opt/areloria/client/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk /opt/areloria/client/dist/arelorian.apk")
print("\n✅ APK ready: https://arelorian.de/arelorian.apk")

c.close()
EOF
